_comment: Worked example of the chain-draft.json contract (see docs/chain-draft-contract.md). This is a PAPER-ROOTED chain, part-way published: steps 01-02 already have URIs (published_uri set), so a wizard would resume at step 03 and seed 03's `aida` field from step 02's URI. Real files are produced by scripts/build_chain_draft.py and are git-ignored.

prefill.quotation: Bumblebee species across North America and Europe are declining in areas where temperatures have increased beyond historical limits.
prefill.comment: This replication tests whether the thermal-exposure signal holds for Iberian Bombus using an equal-area HEALPix regridding, on independent GBIF occurrence data.

prefill.aida: Increased thermal exposure between historical baseline and recent climate predicts higher probability of local extirpation in Iberian Bombus populations.

prefill.label: Thermal exposure predicts Iberian Bombus extirpation
Iberian Bombus thermal-exposure replication
prefill.scope: Tests the headline thermal-exposure-to-extirpation relationship for Iberian Bombus only; does not re-test the North American populations of the original.
prefill.methodology: GBIF Iberian Bombus occurrences regridded to equal-area HEALPix (healpix-geo, nested, depth 6) on the WGS84 ellipsoid; a GLMM of extirpation on standardised thermal-exposure change between 1901-1974 and 2000-2014 baselines.
prefill.deviation: Original used a lat/lon grid; this replication uses equal-area HEALPix to remove the area bias near the poles.

prefill.label: Iberian Bombus thermal-exposure outcome
prefill.conclusion: The thermal-exposure signal holds on the equal-area grid: standardised thermal-exposure change positively predicts local extirpation, consistent in sign with the original.
prefill.evidence: GLMM coefficient on standardised thermal-exposure change +0.454 (95% HDI [+0.130, +0.751]); n = 1,204 occupied cells at depth 6.
prefill.limitations: Single taxon and region; occurrence data are presence-mostly, so absences are inferred rather than surveyed.
